section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1994
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1994 N.C.R.B. - 34 1.3.6.1 The high growth in the number of vehicles in the country has, no doubt, influenced the decline of the rate of Deaths due to Motor Vehicles. However, other highly correlated factors like increased electrifications and better conditions of roads, hi-technology checks using computerised periscope vans, radar guns, video traffic monitors etc coupled with more intensive and extensive monitoring of the vehicular movements by the traffic police are also expected to have contributed to reduction of the road accidental death rate.
